biography:
CAREER HIGHLIGHTSKyle, currently is a Development Project Manager at QTS Data CentersPrevious Kyle was an Entitlement and Acquisitions  Manager at Oakwood Homes. He helped manage and entitle over 3600 homesites within the Denver Metro Area such as Green Valley Ranch, Green Valley Ranch East, and Prairie Point.At D.R. Horton, Kyle was a Forward Planner where he worked with the acquisition team and helped with the entitlement process for over 1,000 homesites.Prior to joining D.R. Horton, Kyle worked at Centerpoint Integrated Solutions for 2 years. At Centerpoint, Kyle managed entitlements and permitting for CarMax and Floor and Decor on over 50 projects. During his time there, he also oversaw civil engineering, geotechnical, surveying and architectural teams. Before CenterPoint, Kyle worked as an associate broker at Transwestern where he  specialized in conducting showings and research for the Hake-Woodward Team as well as representing landlords in the marketing and leasing of office properties located throughout the Denver Metro Area. Kyle also held an internship for a St. Louis based commercial brokerage Gershman Commercial where he gained first-hand exposure to the commercial real estate industry through cold calling, guiding tours, and gathering marketing materials. In addition, Kyle was a Research Analyst Intern for appraisal firm NVC where he was responsible for creating portfolios for appraised properties.One of Kyle’s most recent achievements came in April 2018 when he placed 3rd in a national real estate competition at Villanova, where he presented a skyscraper concept and proforma to Brandywine Realty Trust.
